create_linear_attn_model_spec: create a LinearAttnModelSpec instance with config class, backend class name, and architecture names
register_linear_attn_model: register a linear attention model spec so it is available for runtime lookup
test_get_linear_attn_config: test get_linear_attn_config to look up a spec by isinstance check against a HuggingFace config
build_get_linear_attn_spec_by_arch: build usage of get_linear_attn_spec_by_arch to look up a spec by architecture name string
run_import_backend_class: run import_backend_class to lazily import a backend class from a fully-qualified dotted name
